verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as entity or filing actions, are a fair question for a corporate-compliance and registered-agent service like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two access probes. One shows the Wolters Kluwer host returning a Cloudflare challenge; the other shows the legacy CT host redirecting into that walled host. Neither says anything about bulk-operation capability, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
